label: credential-free local replay of the scheduled Catalog Generation prepare step with the compaction fix

fix.summary: replay of an accepted checkpoint reads payloads up to the 256 MiB checkpoint bound; compaction drops superseded metadata snapshots unless the generation cites them; the 64 MiB retained bound applies after compaction; the publisher retains any typed validation error line

tools.publish: go build ./cmd/starmap-catalog-publish at the fix head with go1.27.1 darwin/arm64

environment: env -i PATH HOME TMPDIR; no provider credential variables; the profile allows missing provider sources

C_accepted_checkpoint.stderr: unresolved_model_reference warnings and info lines only

observation: cited models.dev snapshots accumulate across runs while offering timestamps still stamp them (3 then 4 snapshots, 31.2 then 42.1 MiB); the retained bound now fails closed only after compaction; a later change can lower retention if the accumulation approaches 64 MiB

verifier_fix.summary: the A05 capture binds the publisher tooling paths instead of the whole tree, and the verifier checks the current publication live
